correctness.rationale: The BDF2 update reuses the Gaussian increment ξ_{n−1}; replacing it by fresh noise would change the theorem. Its 3D Markov state (Y_n,Y_{n−1},ξ_n) has a stable linear covariance Lyapunov equation for every z=λh>0. Explicit solution gives C0/(σ²h)=(5z+4)/(2z(z+1)(z+4)) and C1/C0=(12+11z−3z²)/((2z+3)(5z+4)). For k>=2 the homogeneous covariance recurrence has real positive roots for 0<z<=1/2, with q above the larger root, and a positive repeated-root boundary. For z>1/2 roots are R exp(±iθ), whose nonzero real sinusoid has both signs infinitely often (rational and irrational angular orbits). BDF2 underestimates invariant OU variance by relative z²/((z+1)(z+4)) but is strictly closer than backward Euler. Independently numerically solved six covariance Lyapunov systems and computed the exact rational z=1 lag-four witness C4/(σ²h)=−3/2500; finite lags are corroboration, not the infinite sign proof.
